standard.summary: 底层压缩后端。fp8_e4m3 默认；fp8_scaled_e4m3 只在 krea2 / FLUX.2 / Z-Image / Wan2.2 上可用
standard.whenToUse: 不确定时先保持默认，小步数短测后再调。
standard.avoidWhen: 与预检冲突或与其它互斥选项同时开启时。

optionDescriptions.fp8_scaled_e4m3: FP8 E4M3 + per-output-channel 缩放，导出带 scaled_fp8 标记。仅 krea2 / FLUX.2 / Z-Image / Wan2.2 支持，其余架构预检直接拒；压缩目标必须是 backbone，选 text_encoder 或 both 会被拒。

standard_en.summary: The underlying compression backend. fp8_e4m3 is the default; fp8_scaled_e4m3 is only available on krea2 / FLUX.2 / Z-Image / Wan2.2
standard_en.whenToUse: When unsure keep the default; run a short low-step test before changing it.
standard_en.avoidWhen: When it conflicts with preflight, or when a mutually exclusive option is enabled at the same time.

optionDescriptions.fp8_scaled_e4m3: FP8 E4M3 plus per-output-channel scaling, exported with a scaled_fp8 marker. Only krea2 / FLUX.2 / Z-Image / Wan2.2 support it and preflight refuses every other architecture outright; the compression target has to be backbone, and choosing text_encoder or both is refused.

advanced.principle: 底层压缩后端。fp8_e4m3 默认；fp8_scaled_e4m3 逐输出通道存一个缩放系数，比裸 FP8 保住更多动态范围，但架构矩阵限定在 krea2 / FLUX.2 / Z-Image / Wan2.2 且只压 backbone；torchao/quanto 系列需对应依赖可用，启动前建议开探测。

advanced_en.principle: Underlying compression backend. fp8_e4m3 is the default; fp8_scaled_e4m3 stores a scale factor per output channel, preserving more dynamic range than bare FP8, but the architecture matrix is limited to krea2 / FLUX.2 / Z-Image / Wan2.2 and it compresses only the backbone; the torchao/quanto family requires the corresponding dependencies available — run capability detection before launch.
